Title: Which project are we on?
Prompt: Tell me the state: the active project, its client, the Navisworks model and the project inputs folder, and what is ready and what blocks a QC check.

Title: Check an isometric against the model
Prompt: Check the isometric {{?Path of the isometric PDF}} for {{project}} against the Navisworks model, the PMS, the P&ID, the line list and vendor data. Give the verdict first, then a table of FAIL and REVIEW findings with the drawing value, the source value and the source, then what you could not check.

Title: Check a folder of isometrics
Prompt: Check every isometric PDF in {{?Folder with the isometric PDFs}} for {{project}}. Give one row per line with its verdict, then the findings that need attention, and write the report.

Title: Check a redrawn P&ID against the original
Prompt: Compare the redrawn P&ID {{?Path of the redrawn P&ID PDF}} with the client's original {{?Path of the original P&ID PDF}} for {{project}}. List every line, equipment, instrument, tag and note that is missing, extra or different, with the sheet and position.

Title: Check a GA drawing
Prompt: Check the GA drawing {{?Path of the GA drawing PDF}} for {{project}} against the Navisworks model, the P&IDs and the vendor data. Give the verdict first, then the FAIL and REVIEW findings with their sources.

Title: What project inputs do we have?
Prompt: List the project inputs for {{project}} (PMS, line list, P&IDs, vendor data) and say which QC checks each one supports and what is missing.

Title: What does the PMS / client rule say?
Prompt: What does {{?Your question about a spec, class or client rule}} say for {{project}}? Answer from the project inputs and saved rules and give the document and page.

Title: What do we know about this client?
Prompt: What do we know about {{client}}? Use recall and list each rule with its source.

Title: Save what we learned
Prompt: Record what we learned in this chat: corrections, preferences, gotchas and rules that worked. Use learn_record and show me each entry before saving.
